title: Free Image to Video: image to video AI with sound

apiKey.title: Free Image to Video API key
apiKey.description: Your API key from https://freeimagetovideo.ai/settings/apikeys (starts with sk-). It is only sent to freeimagetovideo.ai. API runs need a paid plan: they draw on the plan's daily full-speed allowance, then wait in the relaxed queue.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: What should happen in the clip. With an image URL, describe the motion; without one, describe the whole scene (text to video).
prompt.prefill: the camera slowly pushes in while the lantern light flickers and the river flows past

imageUrl.title: Image URL (first frame)
imageUrl.description: Optional public https image. When set, the photo becomes the first frame (image to video). Leave empty for text to video.

aspectRatio.title: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.description: Output shape: landscape, vertical or square.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Stop waiting after this long. Runs can wait in the relaxed queue; the clip still lands in your library on the site.
